notes: Pilot 1 (S2S/WebRTC): LiveKit Cloud worker + Gemini Live; a synthetic room participant plays the frozen corpus. Profile s2s_transport: Gemini Live is an opaque speech-to-speech stream exposing only first-output (first modelTurn), interruption, turn-complete, and transcription boundaries — there is NO LLM-request/first-token, text-commit, or separate TTS-request/first-chunk event. Those legs are unobservable and deliberately not advertised. turn_gap and the provider/transport spans cross multiple components (caller -> LiveKit -> Gemini -> LiveKit), so they are stack-level evidence, not per-provider pack attribution; pack_metrics stays empty until a span's boundaries isolate a single provider. Budget-lean cohort: >=120 valid turns per cohort; expected spend near $0 on LiveKit/Gemini free tiers (cap is retry headroom). p50/p95 publishable; p99 thin and labeled directional until the cohort is topped up. Provenance (target commit, runtime/SDK, model IDs, machine class) is produced by the adapter at run time into provenance.json, never typed into this template. Adapter contract: evals/measure/adapters/README.md.
